engine: EVER visual-search LEVEL 2 — pick a UNIT on a CLEAN REDRAWN vector floor plan where the NUMBER IS the UI. NOT the developer raw plan image + a wall of text (the smarts mistake). The substrate is inline SVG line-art (white room fills, hairline partitions, heavy near-black perimeter, hatched column squares); each apartment is a transparent footprint <path data-nr ...> in the SAME viewBox as the artwork; each unit gets a small NUMBER PILL placed at its footprint's COMPUTED CENTROID (area-weighted polygon centroid, never hand-placed pixels) so it stays glued under any scale. Hover -> footprint wash (live ~0.12 terracotta / sold-reserved cooler) + pill scales 1->1.1 + a top dark-translucent info card (type + Nº + area + price) fades/slides in; dead units show 'Продано'/'Не в продажу' (no '+'), live units reveal a '+'. '+' click -> Level 3 (onSelect). Left rail = giant floor numeral + Floor dropdown + back + site-locator + compass. Harvested from D_ever_visualsearch_video.md (§3 / Level 2).

measured_teardown.move: discrete, hover-driven (no scroll). Hover ON (~150-220ms ease-out): footprint fill 0 -> ~0.12 wash; matching pill scales 1->1.1 + border darkens to accent; the number swaps to a '+' on live units; the top dark-translucent info card fades + slides in, populated from data-*; dead units show a status word + no '+'. Hover OFF (~180ms) reverses. '+' click -> onSelect (Level 3 expand-from-pill). Floor selector swaps the plan SVG (cross-fade). Pills are static (no cascade); only the hovered unit reacts. Pill positions = each footprint's COMPUTED centroid in SVG space.
measured_teardown.cited: EVER /visual-search/5/28: a clean light floorplate, apartments marked by number pills (292, 296, 297...), hover highlights the footprint + a top card (3E / Nº292 / 60.1 M² / 23 330 820 ₽), 'Not on sale' for dead units; giant 28 + Floor selector + Back-to-housing + compass + site-locator on the left.

vbW.what: the plan artwork's viewBox WIDTH — the shared coordinate space for footprints + pills (no drift).

units.what: [{nr,type,area,price,status('sale'|'sold'|'reserved'),points('x,y x,y ...' image-space footprint snapped to the real wall vectors)}]. The clean plan ARTWORK is authored inline (or passed); footprints+pills are built in its viewBox.

onSelect.what: fn(nr, unit) on '+'/click of a LIVE unit -> drills to Level 3 (veil-flat-detail-reveal).

entry: NumberedFloorplateSelect.create(target, opts) -> { render(units), select(nr), setHover(nr), clear(), built, destroy }. target = .nfp-stage > .nfp-rail(back + .nfp-floornum + .nfp-floorsel + locator + compass) + .nfp-stagecard( svg.nfp-plan (clean artwork) + svg.nfp-zones (built) + .nfp-card (top info) ). The engine locks .nfp-zones to the artwork's viewBox, builds one footprint + one centroid-placed pill per units[] entry, wires hover/click, fills the top card from data-*.
law: SVG fill/stroke + DOM opacity/transform + GSAP only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. NEVER embed the developer raster plan (the whole technique IS the clean redraw). Pills derive from footprint CENTROID in SVG space (glued under scale) — never hand-placed pixels. Footprints share the artwork's viewBox (snap to real walls) so hover regions match rooms. Data join by data-nr (the visual-search-engine pattern); status drives fill class + whether '+'/click exists. reduced-motion / <=820px -> a unit list (number + type + area + price + status). owns_pin false; hover/click, no scroll. Sets window.__LAB_OK__.
gate_mode: hover/click visual-search (not scroll). Verify: the plan is a CLEAN REDRAWN vector (not a raster); each unit has a number pill at its footprint CENTROID (pill inside its footprint bbox); .nfp-zones shares the plan viewBox; hover a LIVE unit -> terracotta wash + pill scale + '+' + top card (type/Nº/area/price); hover a SOLD unit -> cooler wash, no '+', card shows the sold word; '+'/click fires onSelect. NOTE: drive hover via real mouseenter on .nfp-foot; only the hovered unit should wash (clear between).
